name: Dragon Spring Farm
description: Dragon Spring Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 115 Santa Rosa Creek Road, CA. The farm is small, and its seasons run through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
